name: Personal shopper

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Style brief
services.story: The main story: a $55 style brief by video, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Shopping check-in
services.story: A $35 shopping check-in: a card is saved for the $20 late-cancel fee, and the $35 is charged when the shopper texts DONE.

services.name: Shopping day from your list
services.story: A $90 shopping day from the client's list: a $20 deposit now, and the $70 rest on the saved card at DONE.

services.name: Gift pick
services.story: A $25 gift pick at the office: nothing is taken, and the client pays at the front desk.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Shopping trip from home
services.story: The main story: a $179 shopping trip from home; a card is saved for the $89 visit fee and the $179 is charged when the shopper texts DONE.

services.name: Closet and shopping day
services.story: A $640 closet and shopping day, quoted from the client's list photos: a $160 deposit now, and the $480 rest on the bill after.

services.name: Team shopping
services.story: A $179 team shopping visit at a company's office: nothing is taken, and the bill is texted after.

services.name: Shopping visit at home
services.story: A $150 shopping visit at home, paid in full when booking; a late cancel may keep the $89 visit fee.

services_shape: Personal shopping: a style brief and shopping check-ins by video, by phone or at the office (flow A), and a shopping trip that starts at a client's home or a team shopping visit at a company's office (flow B). Every new client starts with a free intro call. Items are bought by the client at the stores, and Rosie never takes money for items.
questions_before_times: What are you shopping for: a look for work or an event, a gift, or a refresh of the closet?
Roughly when, how many items, and how many people?
At the office, by video or phone, or at your home?
safety_stop: someone in danger or hurt right now, at home or in a store
license: No license is needed for this work in most places. A registration or certificate the state asks for is the business's own to add. It is optional, and nothing is looked up.
messages_never: Body measurements, sizes, health or skin concerns, the budget or the items a client shares, and when a home will be empty.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
